Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

propsens 0.1.0

First public release.

  • propensity_sensitivity() checks, before any outcome is used, how much a 1:1 matched design depends on the choice of propensity model. It takes a formula and data with your matching settings, or an existing MatchIt object, whose settings it reads.
  • The model set is logistic regression, BART and the GRF probability forest (three seeds for each tree algorithm: seven models), with cross-fitted scores; every model is matched with the same settings.
  • A quality gate keeps only the models that predict treatment about as well as the best model and whose matched groups are about as well balanced. An R warning is raised when fewer than two models pass, or when the kept models are seeds of a single algorithm.
  • For the kept models it reports rank disagreement (how differently they order the treated patients) and pair instability (how often they choose a different untreated partner), with the bootstrap rank instability of the logistic model and the spread of balance across models.
  • seed_sensitivity() repeats the check with several values of seed; plot() shows the results, and the articles explain the method step by step with the public right heart catheterization study.

Developed by Mostafa M. Abbas.
